feeds.title: Thrifty Minnesota
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Chrysa, and I'm here along with my friends Kristi and Laura to share fun and thrifty ways for you and your family to enjoy all the awesome things Minnesota has to offer!

feeds.title: Real Housewives of Minnesota
feeds.description: Real Housewives of Minnesota is a lifestyle blog by Sarah, a mom from Minnesota. She writes about family life, recipes, fitness tips, parenting, and local adventures. Her posts are simple, friendly, and feel like advice from a friend. It's all about sharing real-life experiences and helpful ideas for busy moms.

feeds.title: The Styled Press
feeds.description: A Minneapolis Fashion, Beauty & Lifestyle Blog by Taylor Brown. She shares her personal style, beauty tips, lifestyle happenings, and whatever else inspires her.

feeds.title: Community Reporter
feeds.description: We are a free monthly newspaper serving Saint Paul's West End neighborhoods, from Downtown to Fort Snelling, since 1970. For over 50 years, the Community Reporter has been bringing the news of the West End to your doorstep.

feeds.title: JackAndKitty
feeds.description: Uncover the best of America's Midwest through buzzing food spots, destinations, and other local hidden gems JackAndKitty is a travel blog featuring Emmy Award-winning travel experts Jack and Kitty Norton from Minnesota sharing the best of the Midwest with plenty of laughs, uff das, and feel-goods along the way.

feeds.title: Bake It With Love
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Angela! I am an avid vintage cookbook collector, recipe creator, animal lover, and total foodie. I love sharing recipes that are new, fun, and creative as well as great classic recipes just like my Grandma used to make!

feeds.title: Kelly Zugay
feeds.description: A Minnesota motherhood blog by Kelly Zugay, Founder of Made by Motherhood. Mom blog, motherhood blog, Minnesota blog.

feeds.title: North MN Outdoors
feeds.description: This blog is to learn something new. To share pictures and observations about nature near Hackensack, Walker, and Akeley Minnesota. To record seasonal changes throughout the spring, summer, and fall in this lake region.

feeds.title: Minnesota Farm Living
feeds.description: My name is Wanda Patsche. My blog is like looking through the window to my life. I open the curtains and share my perspective and truth about agriculture and other important life topics. You will see pictures of my family, my farm, my travel adventures, and beautiful rural Minnesota farm living. In other words. my life.

feeds.title: Pickles Travel
feeds.description: I'm Greta. A Midwestern pickle-eating, travel-loving, Spanish-speaking, Photographer who loves the rural life- preserving its food, stories, and barns! You'll get a lot of travel stories here because I love to share the ever-changing world we live in.

feeds.title: Central Minnesota Mom
feeds.description: Central Minnesota Mom-SAHM of three writing about product reviews and our adventures from daily life. Find product reviews, giveaways, crafts, recipes, technology, travel and more.

feeds.title: Minnesota Yogini
feeds.description: Free Spirited, Inspired, Gymnast Turned Yogi. Travel, Fitness and Lifestyle Blogger, SAHM, Yoga Teacher & Outdoor Enthusiast. Here, I am sharing stories and ideas from my own travels and adventures, as well as tips, lessons learned, and inspiration in hopes to inspire you to live your fullest life, with a healthy body, and a positive mind.

feeds.title: Duck Duck Gray Duck
feeds.description: Navigating the nonsense and spotlighting the profound. Visit Duck Duck Gray Duck daily for a dose of funny pictures, crazy videos, weird news, cool gadgets, and other shareable topics from Minnesota and around the world.

feeds.title: Mosaic Delish
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Mosaic Delish.

feeds.title: Minnesota Mom Blog
feeds.description: Minnesota Mom blog is where I talk about my life and family. I'm Margaret in Minnesota, and this is my mom's-eye perspective of a kid-heavy life. I love the Lord; I take lots of photos; and I always try to tell it like it is, from sex to depression and everything in between! I hope you enjoy your time here.

feeds.title: Minnesota Girl in the World - All Things Travel. Food. Wine. and HER.
feeds.description: A Minnesota Girl who moved away to CA, and fell in love with LA and Wine Country in the process. She has her Minnesota roots ingrained in her to the core, but has embraced life by talking about it. Her loves include photography, travel, wine, art, and reviewing products and events around town.

feeds.title: The Daily Gopher | A Minnesota Golden Gophers Community
feeds.description: Your online home for Minnesota Golden Gophers football, basketball and hockey. Find Minnesota Golden Gophers news, rumors, analysis, stats and scores from the fan perspective.

feeds.title: The Wanderlust Rose
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Emily Rose! I'm currently living out of my suitcase full time and working around the world. Follow along on the adventure, as I cross each experience off my bucket list. On my site, you can find the travel jobs I've worked and where you can apply, how to travel on a budget, packing guides.

feeds.title: Living Smart Girl
feeds.description: Living Smart Girl is a women's guide to health and wellness. Healthy cooking recipes for carnivores and vegetarians. Info on parenting and fitness too.

feeds.title: Bert Anderson
feeds.description: Welcome! Kick up your feet, rest your pretty little mama head, and let's celebrate being moms together. In case you're new here, allow me to introduce myself. I'm Bert. That's me. And yes, I'm a mom too.

feeds.title: The Spur Trail
feeds.description: Adventure by straying from the path. Travel and Lifestyle blog, 'The Spur Trail'. For hilarious stories, unique tips, and inspiration head on over. Greta is the author behind the blog.

feeds.title: Volkman Adventures
feeds.description: A couple of corporate full-timers living our best #bucketlistlife. We're all about travel & adventure, whether it be our own backyard or elsewhere in the world.
